detailed_subject_scene: Describe this image for a video-generation prompt writer. Cover: (1) every visible subject with identity anchors — hair color/length/texture, approximate age, gender presentation, wardrobe items WITH colors, signature accessories, distinguishing props; (2) scene/environment with key set-dressing and spatial layout; (3) lighting and color palette; (4) overall visual style (e.g. cinematic, live-action, 3D CG); (5) camera framing/shot size. Be precise and factual, one paragraph per image, no speculation beyond the visible.
subject_identity_only: Describe ONLY the visible subject(s): identity anchors — hair, age, gender, wardrobe with colors, accessories, distinguishing features. One compact paragraph per image. Ignore background.
scene_only: Describe ONLY the environment: location type, key set-dressing, spatial layout, lighting, color palette, mood-neutral factual tone. One compact paragraph per image. Ignore people.
